facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report during an intrusive maintenance task on P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on P-9503 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 30 November 2015 a hazard report was recorded on P-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
